reference.title: Report Cyber Incidents
reference.shortdesc: How can you report cybersecurity incidents, including phishing attempts? General incident response guidance.

section.title: NC State Campus Reporting Channels
section.p: If you observe signs of a compromised Unity account, phishing attack, malware infection, or university data exposure, report the incident immediately through NC State's Office of Information Technology (OIT):

ul.li: NC State OIT Help Desk: Call 919-515-4357 (HELP) or submit a security incident ticket through the NC State IT Service Portal.
Suspicious Emails and Phishing: Report suspicious emails using Gmail's built-in phishing report feature or forward them to phishing@ncsu.edu.

section.title: Federal and External Cyber Incident Reporting Agencies
section.p: According to the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA), organizations and individuals can also report cyber incidents, phishing attempts, malware, and vulnerabilities through federal and state agencies:

ul.li: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA): Provides secure reporting portals for organizations and constituents to report cyber incidents, phishing attempts, malware, and software vulnerabilities at CISA Reporting a Cyber Incident.

DHS State and Local Fusion Centers: State-operated centers that receive, analyze, and share cyber threat intelligence across federal, state, local, tribal, and territorial agencies and private-sector partners.

Local Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) Field Office: Serves as the lead federal agency for investigating cyberattacks and intrusions, collecting threat intelligence, and working with victims to identify malicious actors.
FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3): Accepts internet crime complaints from both victims and third parties for individual instances of cybercrime and online fraud at ic3.gov.
Local Law Enforcement and Regulatory Agencies: Additional notification channels recommended when observing signs of compromise or regulated data breaches.

section.note: Broader federal and institutional incident reporting procedures primarily apply to NC State faculty and staff handling university data and systems.
